profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Starbucks | M.S. in Computer Science
profile.summary:
Deeply analytical Lead Engineer combining a strong academic background in Computer Science and Software Engineering with an excellent record in architecting, designing, building, and operating critical distributed enterprise applications that scale to millions of users.

Passionate about Functional Programming, Event-driven architectures, and distributed systems, continuously seeking to grow my expertise in technologies I love such as Scala, gRPC, DataDog, Kafka, and Kubernetes. Currently excited about Rust programming language.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led cross-functional teams to design and deliver high-impact software solutions, driving improvements in software quality and team performance.
• Architected and implemented scalable systems to address complex business challenges, ensuring performance and maintainability.
• Mentored and coached engineers, fostering skill development and a collaborative team culture.
• Championed best practices in software development, including Clean Code, Design Patterns, and DevOps workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed core application features, resulting in unlocking key features that will enable new Partnerships for the company.
• Collaborated with product managers and stakeholders to define technical requirements for  the strategic project Benefits Engine(patent)
• Played a key role in transitioning legacy systems to modern architectures, such as first version of Starbucks Rewards Japan Program.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed Microservices using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to tackle complex domains.
• Designed scalable solutions based on Distributed and Reactive Systems principles (Responsive, Resilient, Elastic, and Message-Driven).
• Programmed in Scala, leveraging both Object-Oriented and Functional programming paradigms.
* Conducted Unit Testing and Property-Based Testing to ensure robust application functionality.
• Embraced a DevOps culture, implementing Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD) practices for efficient deployment and operations.

positions.title: Microservices Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Microservices with Scala and Cassandra for Starbucks Japan Rewards Program.
• Implemented Distributed and Reactive Systems to ensure scalability and resilience.
• Conducted Unit and Property-based testing to ensure flawless deployment under a DevOps culture.

positions.title: Senior Integration Consultant
positions.description:
Analyzed requirements provided from telecommunications industry clients. Designed and developed robust, scalable system integration components under a Service Oriented Architecture in accordance with business needs.

Achievements: 
•	Expertly analyzed, designed and developed ~15 complex integration scenarios on 3 major projects for a single telecommunications company, to support a variety of operational processes (assurance, billing, etc.). 

Technical Skills:
•	C#, SQL Server 2008 R2, Net Framework 4.0, C#, WCF, Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate, JMS, Websphere, Biztalk Server 2010, ESB Toolkit 2.1, XML, XSLT, XPath,Visual Studio 2010, Enterprise Architect & Integration Patterns, Windows Server 2008.

positions.title: Development and Technology Engineer
positions.description:
Created innovative and highly functional software components for diverse B2B clients. Used C# for development of Biztalk applications, and Visual Studio for design of orchestrations, maps and Biztalk server pipelines.

Achievements:  
•	Developed a highly available and transactional platform, capable of processing up to 2 million documents per month, for 21 retail chains in Argentina and 92 Mexican retail chains, such as Jumbo, Walmart, Liverpool and Carrefour.

Technical Skills:
•	Net Framework 2.0/3.0, C#, Java, SQL Server 2005, Windows Services, SQL Server 2005, WCF, WWF, BizTalk Server 2006/2006 R2, MSMQ, NServiceBus, XML, XSLT, XPath, Visual Studio 2005/2008, TFS, Unit Testing, Scrum, Windows Server 2005.

positions.title: Senior Development Engineer
positions.description:
Met with clients to determine technology requirements and define project specifications. Designed and developed innovative custom web, mobile and desktop solutions to meet customer requests. 

Achievements:
•	Water Gauges Project: Created a mobile app for Windows Mobile/CE which enabled accurate reading and transmission of water gauge data.
•	Census Project: Development of a mobile app for gathering of population census data using Windows Mobile/CE.
•	Measurement Variables Enterprise Solution: Designed and developed an innovative solution for collection and analysis of measurement variables in a factory’s manufacturing process, comprised of a Windows Mobile/CE app, desktop software on Windows XP with 2 modules (configuration and reports), and sync service between the mobile and desktop apps.

Technical Skills:
•	C#, ASP.net, SQL Server, SQL CE, Access 200, Windows Forms, Web Services and Visual Studio 2003/2005, Windows Mobile/CE.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Research and development to improve the Software Development Process of the company, technical lead

Achievements:
•	Software Process Improvement leader: improving developers productivity, products and process quality by defining a software development process based on ISO 9001:2000 and CMMI and implementing in the company a Control Version System(CVS), a Bug Tracker Management System and a Project Management System, all of them open source.
•	 Technical Lead: Analysis and development of a module of reports with Java, Crystal Reports Application Server and PostgreSQL.

Technical Skills:
•	Linux, Java, Crystal Reports, PHP, JavaScript, PostgresSQL, CVS, Software Process Improvement

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Analysis, design and development of Web applications.

Achievements:
Billing System: Designed and developed a Tenants Management Web Application using PHP, JavaScript and MySql

Technical Skills:
PHP, JavaScript, Mysql, Apache Server

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Gathering and analysis of data through legacy systems databases to load on SAP/R3 PM module, training  and support nivel one for end users.

Technical Skills:
SAP, Excel, Windows
